title: Red car with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- car body -->
    <rect x='10' y='50' width='80' height='26' rx='9' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
    <!-- lighter top edge of body for contrast -->
    <rect x='10' y='50' width='80' height='6' rx='5' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
    <!-- cabin / roof -->
    <path d='M28 50 L36 34 Q38 31 42 31 L64 31 Q68 31 70 34 L78 50 Z' fill='#e02626'/>
    <!-- windshield -->
    <path d='M40 48 L45 36 Q46 34 48 34 L62 34 Q64 34 65 36 L70 48 Z' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
    <!-- windshield shine -->
    <path d='M44 47 L47.5 38 L52 38 L47 47 Z' fill='#d8f4ff'/>
    <!-- headlights -->
    <circle cx='16' cy='60' r='5' fill='#ffe45c'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='60' r='5' fill='#ffe45c'/>
    <!-- wheels -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='4.5' fill='#b8b8cc'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='4.5' fill='#b8b8cc'/>
    <!-- smiling face on the hood/body -->
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='3.4' fill='#3a1030'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3.4' fill='#3a1030'/>
    <circle cx='41.2' cy='56.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='61.2' cy='56.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M42 65 Q50 72 58 65' fill='none' stroke='#3a1030' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
